layout.body:
Subject: Medical appointment
Dear Ms. Patel,
Your appointment at Lakeside Medical Center is scheduled for May 10 at 3:00 P.M. Please arrive 15 minutes early for paperwork. You will be seen by Dr. Liu. Click the link below to confirm. To reschedule or cancel, call us at 756-8793.
Regards,
Brittany Jones

questions.stem: What time should Ms. Patel arrive for her appointment?
questions.analysis: What time should Ms. Patel arrive for her appointment? nguyên văn dựa vào: Your appointment... is scheduled for May 10 at 3:00 P.M. Please arrive 15 minutes early for paperwork. đặt chỗ thời gian làm 5 tháng 10 viết tắt của buổi chiều 3 điểm, mời dời lên ngày sớm hơn 15 phút đạt đến xử lý thủ tục  (A) 10:00 AM → Sai (B) 2:45 PM → Đúng (C) 3:00 PM → Sai (D) 3:15 PM → Sai

questions.stem: How can Ms. Patel cancel her appointment?
questions.analysis: How can Ms. Patel cancel her appointment? nguyên văn dựa vào: To reschedule or cancel, call us at 756-8793.như yêu cầu sắp xếp lại có thể hủy, mời gọi điện 756-8793  (A) By replying to the e-mail → Sai (B) By clicking a link → Sai (C) By calling a phone number → Đúng (D) By sending a text message → Sai
